name: Canteen
description: Two optional checks at supper. Neither changes the order.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and the stores receipt for their requisition is clipped to his board. This is about the vial.
outcomes.success: He reads every other section without lifting his head, and looks up for theirs. He came to watch this one land.
outcomes.failure: It sounds like a duty list.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They decide it's the easiest job on the list, he read it so evenly.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: "I did the drains my first month. Something nests down there every spring. Get up on the walkways and stay out of the water."
outcomes.success: "Something lives down there. Keep out of the water if you can." He doesn't want to be asked again.
outcomes.failure: He makes a joke of it and asks about the pickles.
outcomes.criticalFailure: He laughs it off so well that they decide there's nothing down there.
